purpose: Anchor the band-closure verification stack to K0726 (repo-established 5x18/5x19 curve census) with a fresh, method-independent TS reimplementation (this file records the run of scripts/ts_census_k0726_anchor.js)

systems.A_horizontal_chord: same-row chord pair + third point in a different row; completeness by pigeonhole (>=7 points on 5 rows => some row has >=2 points); exact integer arithmetic
systems.B_all_triples: all C(5m,3) triples, integer Cramer solve, collinear skipped; independent of the pigeonhole argument
systems.A_immediate: system A with per-construction point counting (memory-light, for band widths)

verdicts.k0726_m19: MATCH - K0726 states 95 circles (exactly-7pt: 8, exactly-8pt: 87, >=9pt: 0) + 5 row lines, and reports 64,980 row-pair constructions, 132,180 triple constructions, 83,471 distinct circles. All values reproduced exactly by both systems.
verdicts.k0726_m18: MATCH - K0726 states 84 circles (7pt: 4, 8pt: 80). Both systems reproduce exactly.
verdicts.records_m35: MATCH - records.jsonl m=35 meta curves=244 equals 239 circles + 5 row lines from the fresh implementation.
verdicts.A_vs_B: AGREE at both m=18 and m=19 (same circle sets by identical counts and histograms).
verdicts.chain: This anchors: K0726 <-> this TS stack <-> (13/13 curve-count match at m=35..49, ts-census-check.json) <-> genfast3 sweep records, and K0726 <-> sat2 (via the 5x18/5x19 def-mode byte-identity samples). The third-system full-band table (ts-census-fullband.json, m=35..157) is therefore anchored to a repo-established census at the band head.
